text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My first three years with
Victoire Pisa have come to an end.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey!
Did you watch the Arima Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Old Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That was amazing, wasn't it?
I feel like I got another push forward.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha! My grandchild suddenly dragged out
a lantern the other day, you know."

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
"She said she wanted to support her, so in the middle of the night—
Huh, yours did too?"

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text: "Victoire Pisa is the embodiment of miracles."

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
"I'm going to Japan soon just to see her.
I've even started interacting with Japanese racing fans."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, it arrived.
I suppose it's about time for a replacement...
I've been using it for quite a long time, after all.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: There's still enough light, but...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Is that...
Universe-san?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ..."Communication"――"Communication"――

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: The "Orbital Resonance" between "her" and "him"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: The "Orbital Resonance" between "her" and "her"...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Um... Universe-san, good evening.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It's a beautiful sky, isn't it?
Mind if I join you...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Affirmative—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
My, tonight... the stars are so clearly visible.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Neo Universe continued to gaze up at the night sky for a while.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then, suddenly—
she pointed toward the night sky, gesturing far... to the west.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Do you... 'like' kebabs?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...A kebab, is it?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Umm... I do like them.
They wrap up so many vegetables,
and they're very delicious, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
How about rice balls?
Sandwiches, hot dogs,
galettes, falafel—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Japan", "United Kingdom", "United States of America",
"French Republic", "Emirate of Dubai"—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"CNT"—"Connect."
"New Panorama"... "EITOR"
Or—"PRSP."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
You can...
"choose" your "FTR"... your future.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
That is "HPED"—
a single... "Epilogue."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Singularity."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...—
A future... to choose...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, I hadn't properly talked with her
about our future plans yet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Over these past three years, we've connected and expanded our circle.
Now, that circle has spread across the entire world."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The map ahead is completely blank.
You could continue striving in domestic races,

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as Neo Universe (presumably) showed, we might even be able to go abroad.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.
choice_data_list: As you are now, you can go anywhere.
As you are now, you can go anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly,
she looks up at the sky.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...The 'Arima Kinen'...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It was all of you
who guided me to that place.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Every ray of light you showed me throughout those days
was so warm, and so precious."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
“—Therefore,
there is only one future I desire.”

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"I won't say for all eternity.
However, for as long as possible."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
That circle of bonds connecting the whole world—
I want to preserve it far into the future.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: A circle has no physical form. It does not matter where it is.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Wherever I go, I want to bring more people into our circle
and connect with them.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
And as long as I live,
I, too, wish to remain within this circle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Valuing the circle and keeping it connected.
It was an answer so true to who she was."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...Won't you stand by my side
as well?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa fixed her calm gaze
steadily upon me.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: "I want to stay by the side of your resolve."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: "‘I want to stay by the side of your resolve.’"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
You once told me that before,
didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
The words from that day…… and your very presence,
have supported me more than you could ever know.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Please continue to stand by my resolve,
from this moment on and into the future."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: You as well... for as long as you live.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Victoire Pisa, an Umamusume dedicated to helping others.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seizing glory with all her might,
she brought hope to her homeland as it groaned under national hardship.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet we must not forget. She brought hope
not merely to a single nation, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That she created a 'circle of shared feelings' connecting people all over the world.
Even now, that circle continues to connect the racing world.
